definitions.explanation: The act of removing or getting rid of something unwanted, harmful, or unnecessary. Used in medical, cleaning, technical, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {汚|よご}れを{除去|じょきょ}する。
{手術|しゅじゅつ}で{腫瘍|しゅよう}を{除去|じょきょ}した。
examples.english: The tumor was removed by surgery.

examples.japanese: {地雷|じらい}の{除去|じょきょ}{作業|さぎょう}は{危険|きけん}を{伴|ともな}うが、{平和|へいわ}のために{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Landmine removal work is dangerous, but essential for peace.

notes:
A する verb used across many domains. More formal than {取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (to remove), which is the everyday equivalent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚|よご}れを{除去|じょきょ}する (to remove stains/dirt)
- {障害|しょうがい}を{除去|じょきょ}する (to remove obstacles)
- {不純物|ふじゅんぶつ}を{除去|じょきょ}する (to remove impurities)
- {地雷|じらい}{除去|じょきょ} (landmine removal)
- {除去|じょきょ}{手術|しゅじゅつ} (removal surgery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {撤去|てっきょ} — removal of structures or installations (demolition, dismantling)
- {除去|じょきょ} — removal of substances, contaminants, or harmful things
